banner.title: We value your privacy
banner.text: This site uses cookies that are necessary for it to work, including one that remembers your language. With your permission it also uses cookies to count visits anonymously. You can change your choice at any time in Cookie settings. Read more in the <link>Cookie Policy</link>.

preferences.title: Your cookie options
preferences.intro: tsyvinda.com uses two types of cookies, described below. Strictly necessary cookies are always on because the site cannot work without them; analytics cookies are used only if you allow them. To learn more, read the <link>Cookie Policy</link>.

necessary.name: Strictly necessary cookies
necessary.description: Needed for the site to work and to keep it secure: your cookie choice, your language, sign-in sessions and Cloudflare's bot protection. They do not track you and cannot be switched off.

analytics.name: Analytics cookies
analytics.description: Google Analytics counts visits and shows which pages are read, anonymously and in aggregate. It helps decide what to write next. Nothing is loaded from Google unless you allow it.
